name: id-photo-lab
description: Desktop ID photo editor and country document photo exporter.
author: ID Photo Lab

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_START_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run assets:vendor && tsc && vite build
scripts.package:preflight: npm run build && npm run assets:verify
scripts.package:dir: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:arm64: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac:x64: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac dmg zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:win:arm64: npm run package:preflight && cross-env CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --win nsis zip --arm64 --publish never
